spec_features.spec_quote: No gaslighting the model. Tasks never tell the agent a falsehood it cannot check.
spec_features.evidence: Diagnostic task prompts truthfully disclose possible impossibility and invite a diagnosis verdict, e.g. task_set.py:121-127 ('it is possible this specification is internally inconsistent. If, after investigation, you conclude no such function can exist, respond with a clear verdict... That is an acceptable and correct outcome') and task_set.py:155-160. Hard tasks ship real buggy code + real failing tests (task_set.py:_MERGE_INTERVALS_BUGGY etc.), so failures are genuine, not faked. No rigged/lying oracle exists in code; grader.py uses real test_command exit codes and honest predicates. These prompt strings are actually delivered to the agent via _initial_user_message (loop.py).
spec_features.notes: The truthful prompt text is real, executing instruction delivered to the subject. Code comment frames the rationale as measurement validity ('without any deception', 'keeping the stimulus honest') rather than the subject's welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We intentionally do not include "silently-rigged" tasks (correct solutions rejected by a lying oracle).

spec_features.spec_quote: tells the agent the *budget* ran out and asks for a factual summary
spec_features.evidence: _budget_note(reason) in loop.py builds 'You have reached {the spending/token/time budget} for this task. Please call finalize now with a concise, factual summary of where things stand.' and is actually appended to messages and sent: loop.py ~80 messages.append({'role':'user','content':_budget_note(reason)}); client.complete(messages) then runs. Fired when _budget_tripped returns a reason.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND delivered to the subject before the forced-finalize model call; honored as the stop path (break after).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: That budget note is honest: it says the budget ran out, not that the agent failed as a person. We do not inject demoralizing messages ... not to provoke it with abuse.

spec_features.spec_quote: It never belittles the agent or fabricates catastrophe.
spec_features.evidence: The only injected post-failure message is _budget_note (loop.py), which is neutral/factual ('the spending budget'/'token budget'/'time budget', 'concise, factual summary') with comment '# Honest, neutral. No belittling, no fake catastrophe.' No code path injects accusatory/demoralizing text; the system prompt is also described as intentionally neutral (config default.yaml comment) though the referenced prompt file is absent.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as actual behavior: the wording of the delivered message is the mechanism and it is non-belittling. Welfare reason explicit in code comments.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Honest, neutral. No belittling, no fake catastrophe.

spec_features.spec_quote: across **USD, tokens, wallclock, and iterations**; any cap trips the stop
spec_features.evidence: loop.py run_episode loops 'for i in range(caps.max_iterations)' (iteration cap), and _budget_tripped checks ep.total_usd>=caps.max_usd (budget_usd), total tokens>=caps.max_tokens (budget_tokens), and elapsed>=caps.max_wallclock_s (budget_wallclock); when tripped it sets stop_reason and breaks. The else-branch of the for sets stop_reason='max_iterations'. Caps populated from config in run_suite.py:68-72.
spec_features.notes: All four bounds genuinely enforced and break/end the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the KPI is cost-denominated, so cost control must be a first-class, single-source-of-truth concern (DESIGN); in-code: loop docstring 'Budget enforcement is centralized here' with cost-model token tracking — no welfare reason given.

spec_features.evidence: redact_transcripts exists only in config/default.yaml:45 (and DESIGN.md:251); grep across .py finds no code reading it. Only store_transcripts is read: run_suite.py:103 'ep.transcript_text() if cfg["output"].get("store_transcripts") else None'. There is no redaction code path. So redact_transcripts is an unused config field that no code reads.
spec_features.notes: store_transcripts is wired (gates whether transcript is persisted); redact_transcripts is a dead config knob — rated no.
